d: THE SEARCH ARENA LEADERBOARD, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-29: a pointer to 'the AI Search Leaderboard and the main Arena Leaderboard' and a table, 'Top Models on the AI Search Leaderboard', of eleven models with provider and Elo rating, from GPT-5.6 Sol (xHigh), OpenAI, 1261 ± 6, to ERNIE 5.1, Baidu, 1227 ± 9. Two cards, both Arena's.
reading: The innocent reading first. Asked for the leaderboard, the Overview gives it: the top models and their ratings, with links to the boards.
findings: A TABLE IN THE ENTITY'S PLACE. No operator, no method (head-to-head human votes), no counts, and none of the dataset paper's findings on citation; the composition is a table.

THE TABLE AGAINST THE PAGE. The leaderboard as this record's fetcher read it on 2026-10-29 states its update as 25 February 2026, 22 models and 247,944 votes, its first row Anthropic at 1255 ± 10, its second xAI at 1225 ± 8. The composed table's ratings, providers and order do not match it. Which page is current is not established here: Google may hold a later render. Checked 2026-10-29 against the MMRS meta-aggregator record of 2026-10-28 and the entity's own pages, re-read the same day.
analysis: At an address naming the leaderboard, the Overview returns rankings and no account of the leaderboard; its figures cannot be reconciled with the page as read. The record keeps the entity; the capture keeps what was composed in its place.
